visual.altText: Joana stands at the calm river ferry landing, holding the closed hard red violin case. The delayed ferry is moored beside a notice board with unreadable writing; the opposite bank is visible.
Joana studies the town map near the landing worker, with the closed red case at her feet. The upstream path is visible; an adult boat operator prepares a small moored boat nearby. Daylight is clear.

Joana holds the closed red case at the junction of landing and riverside path. An older adult musician gestures along the path; the boat operator waits beside the moored small boat. No crossing has begun.

At the north-bank music-hall entrance, Joana returns the closed red case to her adult teacher while the older musician smiles in recognition. The riverside path ends nearby; soft daylight lights the entrance.
Inside the music hall, Joana sits beside a window after returning the red case to her adult teacher, who holds it near the rehearsal area. Daylight through the window reveals the calm river beyond.
